## 🐛 Bug Description

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 📋 Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Speak / interact with '...'
4. See error

## ✅ Expected Behavior

What you expected to happen.

## ❌ Actual Behavior

What actually happened. Include any error messages from the console.

## 📸 Screenshots / Screen Recording

If applicable, add screenshots or a screen recording.

## 🖥️ Environment

- **OS:** [e.g. macOS 14, Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04]
- **Browser:** [e.g. Chrome 120, Firefox 121, Safari 17]
- **Node/Bun version:** [e.g. Node 20.x, Bun 1.x]
- **Deployment:** [e.g. local dev, Vercel, Render, Docker]

## 🔇 Audio / Microphone Details (if relevant)

- Microphone type: [e.g. built-in, USB, Bluetooth]
- Browser microphone permission: [granted / denied]

## 📝 Additional Context

Any other context about the problem here.

## 🔍 Possible Solution (optional)

If you have an idea for a fix, describe it here.
